bio.text: Tammy Baldwin was elected to the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin in November 2012 and won a third term in 2024; she was the first woman to serve as a U.S. Senator from Wisconsin.
She served seven terms in the U.S. House of Representatives beginning in 1998, after serving on the Dane County Board of Supervisors from 1986 to 1994 and three terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly.
She was born in Madison, Wisconsin, studied political science and mathematics at Smith College, and received her law degree from the University of Wisconsin Law School in 1989.
